title.en: 4.1 GIS and HGIS: purpose and classification
title.gu: 4.1 GIS તથા HGIS: હેતુ અને વર્ગીકરણ

h.en: GIS and HGIS: purpose and classification
h.gu: GIS તથા HGIS: હેતુ અને વર્ગીકરણ

body.en:
Definition

A gas-insulated substation encloses major HVconducting/switching parts in earthed metal compartments using a specified insulating medium; HGIScombines gas-insulated modules with air-insulated connections/equipment.

Classification / scope

  • AIS: main insulation in air; GIS: enclosed gas-insulated assemblies; HGIS: hybrid arrangement.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Compactness helps urban/space-constrained HVsites; enclosure reduces environmental exposure but introduces compartment, gas-handling, access and specialised repair requirements.
  • AIS, GISand HGISare installation/insulation arrangements, not supply functions. AGIS can be a transmission or distribution node.
  • SF 6has excellent insulating/arc-quenching properties but high greenhouse impact; alternative-gas systems have their own verified ratings and procedures, not interchangeable refill gases.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

GIS major HV conducting/switching partsને specified insulating medium સાથે earthed metal compartmentsમાં રાખે; HGIS gas modules/air-insulated connectionsનું combination છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • AIS: air; GIS: enclosed gas assemblies; HGIS: hybrid arrangement.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Compact GIS urban/constrained HV siteમાં ઉપયોગી; enclosure pollution exposure ઘટાડે પણ compartment, gas handling/access/special repair જરૂરી બને.
  • AIS/GIS/HGIS insulation arrangements છે, supply functions નહીં; GIS transmission/distribution node હોઈ શકે.
  • SF 6 insulation/arc-quenching સારી પણ high greenhouse impact ધરાવે; alternative gas systemsના જુદા ratings/procedures છે, interchangeable refill નહીં.

h.en: GIS bay construction and switching roles
h.gu: GIS Bay Construction તથા Switching Roles

body.en:
Definition

A GISbay is a coordinated set of enclosed switching, measurement and connection modules whose compartment boundaries and device duties are defined by the manufacturer.

Construction / parts and connections

  1. Earthed metal enclosure and gas-tight partitions define pressure/maintenance zones; pass-through insulators support conductors and may or may not form gas barriers.
  2. CB, disconnector and earth-switch drives/contacts have individual rated duties and verified position/interlock mechanisms.
  3. CT/PTor VTmodules supply measurement/protection; never open a live CTsecondary or short-circuit a VTsecondary.
  4. Cable/line/transformer terminations, bus modules and viewports provide specified interfaces and inspection access.
  5. Pressure-relief devices route exceptional overpressure; density monitors and local indicators supervise the insulating medium.

Working / functional sequence

  1. Insulating gas and solid supports maintain dielectric strength; the enclosure remains bonded to station earth.
  2. Interlocked devices switch only within their respective duties; protection trips the appropriate interrupting device on a fault.

Detailed explanation and application

  • ACB interrupts specified load/fault current; a disconnector establishes isolation; earth switches connect designated isolated parts to earth. These functions are not interchangeable.
  • Non-fault-initiating earthing arrangements are intended to avoid creating a fault during their designed operation. High-speed earthing switches may have rated short-circuit making/induced-current duties; neither label grants arbitrary live operation.
  • Three-position devices provide mutually interlocked connected, isolated and earthed positions according to design. Aviewport offers a specified view, not complete proof of isolation/deadness.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

GIS bay enclosed switching, measurement/connection modulesનો coordinated set છે; compartment boundaries/device duties OEM નક્કી કરે છે.

Construction / ભાગો તથા જોડાણ

  1. Earthed enclosure/gas-tight partitions pressure/maintenance zones બનાવે; pass-through insulator gas barrier હોય/નપણ હોય.
  2. CB/disconnector/earth contacts-driveના જુદા duties/position-interlocks છે.
  3. CT/PT(VT)measurement/protection આપે; live CT secondary open/VT secondary short નહીં.
  4. Terminations, bus modules/viewports specified interface/inspection આપે.
  5. Relief device abnormal pressure route કરે; density monitors/indicators medium supervise કરે.

Working / કાર્યનો ક્રમ

  1. Gas/solid supports dielectric strength આપે; enclosure earth bond જાળવે.
  2. Devices પોતાની dutyમાં switch કરે; faultમાં protection યોગ્ય CB trip કરે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • CB specified load/fault current interrupt કરે; disconnector isolate/earth switch designated parts earth કરે—interchangeable નહીં.
  • Non-fault-initiating arrangements designed operationમાં fault avoid કરે.High-speed earth switch rated making/induced duty ધરાવી શકે; labelથી arbitrary live operation permission નહીં.
  • Three-positionમાં connected, isolated/earthed interlocked positions હોય.Viewport specified view આપે, complete isolation/dead proof નહીં.

h.en: Gas density, pressure relief and routine checklist
h.gu: Gas Density, Pressure Relief તથા Routine Checklist

body.en:
Definition

GISgas supervision checks the state and containment of the insulating medium; temperature-compensated density is more directly related to gas quantity than uncompensated pressure alone.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Pressure changes with temperature even without leakage. Compare compensated density or manufacturer reference curves, compartment identity and time trend.
  • Routine checklist: alarm health, density trend, position agreement, drive supply, counters, earthing, external corrosion/leak indications, partial-discharge evidence and clear pressure-relief areas.
  • Alarm/block/trip thresholds are equipment-specific. Density-low must not be reset or bypassed merely to close the bay; gas recovery, testing and leak repair require trained specialists.
  • No student releases SF 6or creates decomposition products; room ventilation, oxygen-deficiency assessment, gas analysis and PPEfollow the actual specialist work procedure.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. For a fixed ideal gas volume, p∝mT; therefore p/Ttracks mass approximately when absolute pressure and kelvin temperature are used.
  2. At unchanged mass, 6bar absolute at 293Kwould become≈6.41bar at 313K. This is a simple gas-law example, not a real SF 6density calibration or alarm setting.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

GIS gas supervision insulating mediumની state/containment તપાસે; temperature-compensated density quantity બતાવવામાં raw pressure કરતાં વધુ યોગ્ય છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Leak વિના પણ temperatureથી pressure બદલાય; compensated density/OEM curve, compartment/time trend compare કરો.
  • Checklist: alarm, density, position, drive supply, counters, earth, corrosion/leak, PD evidence/clear relief area.
  • Alarm/block/trip thresholds model-specific; bay close કરવા low-density bypass નહીં.Gas recovery/test/repair trained specialists કરે.
  • Student SF 6 release/decomposition નકરે; ventilation, oxygen risk, analysis/PPE specialist procedure મુજબ.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Fixed ideal volumeમાં p∝mT; absolute p/kelvin Tથી p/T mass આશરે track કરે.
  2. Same massમાં6bar absolute/293Kથી313K પર≈6.41bar; simple gas-law example છે, actual SF 6calibration/alarm નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

HVDCtransmission transfers bulk electrical power through a DCconnection between converter stations that exchange power with ACsystems.

Classification / scope

  • Arrangement: monopole/bipole/back-to-back; technology: LCC/VSC; route: overhead/cable/mixed.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Long-distance overhead/cable links, asynchronous interconnection and renewable integration can benefit from controlled power flow; converter cost/loss, filters and system strength affect selection.
  • Monopole, bipole and back-to-back describe connection arrangements; LCCand VSCdescribe converter technologies. These are different classification axes.
  • LCCuses line-commutated thyristor valves and needs commutation support; VSCuses controllable semiconductor valves and different control/filter characteristics. Do not claim every HVDClink works identically.
  • Source “DCtransformers” is corrected here: conventional stations use AC-side converter transformers. An ordinary magnetic transformer cannot transform steady DC.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

HVDC transmission converter stations વચ્ચે DCconnectionથી bulk power transfer કરે અને stations ACsystems સાથે exchange કરે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Arrangement: monopole/bipole/back-to-back; technology: LCC/VSC; route: overhead/cable/mixed.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Long-distance overhead/cable, asynchronous interconnection/renewablesમાં controlled flow લાભદાયી; converter cost/loss, filters/system strength selection બદલે.
  • Monopole, bipole/back-to-back arrangement છે; LCC/VSC converter technology છે—અલગ axes.
  • LCC thyristor/commutation support લે; VSC controllable valves/different controls-filter ધરાવે; દરેક HVDC સમાન નહીં.
  • Source “DC transformers” માટે correction: conventional stationમાં AC-side converter transformers; ordinary transformer steady DC transform નહીં કરે.

body.en:
Definition

A converter station combines power-electronic conversion with AC/DCinterfaces, filters, reactive support, protection and controls to manage DCpower transfer within operating limits.

Construction / parts and connections

  1. ACswitchyard and converter transformer adapt ACvoltage, insulation and phase arrangement as required.
  2. Valve hall/valve modules, cooling and firing/control equipment perform conversion under controlled environment.
  3. Filters, reactors, DCswitchgear, line/cable terminations and neutral/electrode arrangement follow the designed pole scheme.

Working / functional sequence

  1. Rectifying operation converts AC-side energy to DC; remote inversion delivers energy to the other ACnetwork.
  2. Controllers regulate power/current/voltage subject to equipment limits; power reversal method depends on converter/link technology.

Detailed explanation and application

  • ACfilters reduce specified harmonics and may provide reactive support; DCfilters/smoothing reactors depend on technology and link design. Filters do not eliminate every disturbance.
  • Power order, DCvoltage/current, converter firing/modulation and protection coordinate with the remote terminal; loss of commutation or valve/cooling health can constrain transfer.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Converter station power-electronic conversion, AC/DCinterface, filters, reactive support/protection-controlsથી DCtransfer limitsમાં manage કરે છે.

Construction / ભાગો તથા જોડાણ

  1. AC switchyard/converter transformer required voltage, insulation/phase adaptation આપે.
  2. Valve hall/modules, cooling/firing-control conversion કરે.
  3. Filters, reactors, DCswitchgear, line/cable/neutral-electrode pole scheme મુજબ.

Working / કાર્યનો ક્રમ

  1. Rectification ACથી DC/remote inversion બીજા AC networkને energy આપે.
  2. Controls limitsમાં P/I/V regulate કરે; reversal method technology પર આધારિત.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • AC filters specified harmonics ઘટાડે/ reactive support આપી શકે; DCfilters/reactor technology મુજબ; બધા disturbances દૂર નહીં.
  • Power order, VDC/IDC, firing/modulation/protection remote terminal સાથે coordinate થાય; commutation/valve-cooling problem transfer limit કરે.

body.en:
Definition

HVDCpole voltage is the voltage of one pole relative to its reference; pole-to-pole voltage is the difference between positive and negative poles in a bipole.

Detailed explanation and application

  • In a balanced±500kVbipole, the pole-to-pole difference is 1000 kV, not 500 kV. Current in each conductor is the link current; do not add two conductor currents and double-count power.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. Neglect losses: P=VppIdc=2VpoleIdc for balanced bipole.1000MWat 1000kVtherefore requires 1000 A.
  2. One 500kVpole at 1000Acarries 500MWprovided its rated return arrangement permits monopolar operation.
  3. For a classroom chain of two 98.5%converters and a 98%line, ηtotal=0.985²×0.98≈95.08%; 1000MWinput gives≈950.82MWoutput. Actual efficiency depends on load and equipment.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Pole voltage એક poleનું reference સામે voltage છે; pole-to-pole positive-negative poles વચ્ચે difference છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Balanced±500kVમાં pole-to-pole 1000 kV છે, 500 નહીં; દરેક conductorમાં link current—બંને currents ઉમેરી power double નહીં.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Losses neglected: P=VppIdc=2VpoleIdc; 1000 MW/1000kVથી1000 A.
  2. 500kVpole/1000Aમાં500 MW—rated return arrangement monopolar operation permit કરે ત્યારે.
  3. Classroom two 98.5%converters/98%lineમાં η=0.985²×0.98≈95.08%; 1000MWinput→≈950.82MWoutput. Actual efficiency load/equipment મુજબ.

h.gu: HVDC Valve/Filter Maintenance તથા Digital Monitoring

body.en:
Definition

HVDCcondition supervision combines converter electrical quantities, thermal/cooling state and equipment diagnostic data so that faults and deterioration are recognised without defeating protection.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Monitor DCV/I, ripple, ACquality, valve temperatures, cooling flow/conductivity where applicable, filter unbalance, arrester events and time-synchronised alarms.
  • Authorised isolated valve work requires discharge/earthing, blocked firing and stored-energy verification; optical/control/cooling checks follow the manufacturer and specialist permit.
  • Filter maintenance checks capacitor/resistor/reactor condition, unbalance/protection, connections and discharge paths; harmonic records are compared at comparable power/system conditions.
  • Digital models support diagnosis but are not evidence that a real valve hall or physical gas system was tested.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

HVDC supervision electrical quantities, thermal/cooling/diagnostic dataથી deterioration/fault ઓળખે, protection bypass વિના.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • DC V/I, ripple, ACquality, valve temperature, cooling flow/conductivity, filter unbalance/arrester/time alarms જુઓ.
  • Isolated valve workમાં discharge/earth, firing block/stored-energy verify; optical/control/cooling OEM/specialist permit મુજબ.
  • Filterમાં capacitor/resistor/reactor, unbalance/protection, joints/discharge; harmonics comparable P/system સાથે compare કરો.
  • Digital models diagnosis support કરે; real valve hall/gas physically tested તેનો evidence નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition is a system that acquires time-qualified field data, presents operational state and supports authorised supervisory commands through a communication/control architecture.

Construction / parts and connections

  1. Process/field level: measurement, actuation and local feedback.
  2. Bay level: IEDs/RTUs/PLCs, protection and interlocks.
  3. Station/control-centre level: servers, gateway, HMI, engineering tools, time source and secured networks.

Working / functional sequence

  1. Acquire and scale data, attach quality/time, validate limits and display alarms/trends.
  2. Authorise/select a valid command, check permissives, execute through control equipment and confirm actual feedback or time out safely.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Benefits include remote visibility, alarm/event history, trend analysis and coordinated operation; latency, cyber risk, communications failure and bad data remain limitations.
  • Field sensors/CT/VTand switch contacts feed IEDs/RTUsor PLCs; station network/gateway connects servers, HMIand the control centre through controlled interfaces.
  • Protection trips must not depend only on an HMIor wide-area SCADApath. Local protection/interlocks continue as engineered during loss of supervisory communications.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

SCADA field data time-quality સાથે મેળવે, operational state બતાવે અને communication/controlથી authorised supervisory commands support કરે છે.

Construction / ભાગો તથા જોડાણ

  1. Process/field: measurement, actuation/local feedback.
  2. Bay: IED/RTU/PLC, protection/interlocks.
  3. Station/control centre: servers, gateway, HMI, engineering/time/secured network.

Working / કાર્યનો ક્રમ

  1. Data acquire/scale, quality/time, limits/alarms-trends.
  2. Authorise/select command, permissives, execute/feedback confirm અથવા safe timeout.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Remote visibility, alarm/history, trends/coordination લાભ છે; latency, cyber, communication failure/bad data limitations રહે.
  • Sensors/CT/VT/contacts IED/RTU/PLCને data આપે; station network/gateway servers, HMI/control centre જોડે.
  • Protection માત્ર HMI/wide-area SCADA પર depend નહીં; communication lossમાં local protection/interlocks engineered રીતે રહે.

h.gu: HMI, OWS, EWS તથા Implementation Sequence

body.en:
Definition

An HMIis the operator-facing interface; an OWSis an operator workstation for authorised operation; an EWSis an engineering workstation for controlled configuration and maintenance.

Detailed explanation and application

  • An operator display shows SLD, state, quality, analogue values, alarms and command results; an engineering screen may alter configuration/settings and must have stricter access/change control.
  • Implementation: define point list and naming/units; choose architecture/protocols; configure scaling, alarms, roles and interlocks; test with simulated points before controlled FAT/SAT/commissioning.
  • Validate loss-of-comms, stale/bad status, wrong device selection, command timeout, time synchronisation and backup restoration; screen colour alone is not a safety proof.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

HMI operator-facing interface છે; OWS authorised operation માટે workstation; EWS controlled configuration/maintenance માટે engineering workstation છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Operator display SLD, state, quality, values, alarms/results બતાવે; engineering screen configuration/settings બદલે, એટલે stricter access/change control.
  • Implementation: point list/names/units; architecture/protocols; scaling, alarms, roles/interlocks; simulation પછી controlled FAT/SAT/commissioning.
  • Comms loss, stale/bad status, wrong device, timeout, time/backup restore test; screen colour safety proof નહીં.

h.en: Digital substation: GOOSE, MMSand sampled values
h.gu: Digital Substation: GOOSE, MMS તથા Sampled Values

body.en:
Definition

A digital substation uses interoperable digital communication and data models for measurement, protection, control and engineering while retaining the required physical insulation, interrupting and safety functions.

Detailed explanation and application

  • GOOSEis fast publisher–subscriber event exchange over engineered networks; MMSsupports client–server supervisory/reporting services; sampled values convey digitised measurement streams.
  • Process bus and station bus are functional network roles; merging units, dataset engineering, time sync, redundancy and network performance require end-to-end testing.
  • IEC 61850does not by itself make a station cybersecure or guarantee every device interoperates without configuration. Amissing/stale GOOSEmessage needs engineered failure behaviour.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Digital substation measurement, protection/control/engineering માટે digital communication/data models વાપરે; physical insulation, interrupting/safety duties યથાવત્ રહે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • GOOSE fast publisher-subscriber events; MMS client-server supervisory/reporting; sampled values digitised measurement streams છે.
  • Process/station bus functional roles છે; merging units, datasets, time, redundancy/performance end-to-end test જોઈએ.
  • IEC 61850થી automatic cybersecurity/configuration-free interoperability નથી મળતી.Missing/stale GOOSE માટે failure behaviour જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition

A smart grid coordinates sensing, communication, automation and controllable resources to improve system operation while preserving security, reliability and human authority.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Functions include demand response, distributed-energy coordination, outage management, advanced metering and asset analytics; not every site needs every feature.
  • Use role-based least privilege, separate operator/engineering accounts, network segmentation, secured remote access, logging, configuration backups and controlled patches.
  • Validate commands with device identity, status quality/freshness, authority, interlocks and feedback; communications encryption alone does not remove unsafe process logic.
  • Cyber incident response coordinates safe local operation, communication isolation where authorised, evidence retention and tested recovery—not impulsive shutdown of protection DC.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Smart grid sensing, communication, automation/controllable resources coordinate કરીને operation સુધારે અને security, reliability/human authority જાળવે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Demand response, DER coordination, outage management, advanced metering/asset analytics functions છે; દરેક siteને બધું જરૂરી નહીં.
  • Role-based least privilege, operator/engineering accounts અલગ, segmentation, secure remote access, logs, backup/controlled patch રાખો.
  • Commandsમાં ID, quality/freshness, authority, interlock/feedback; encryptionથી unsafe logic દૂર નથી થતું.
  • Incident response safe local operation, authorised communication isolation, evidence/recovery coordinate કરે—protection DC impulsively બંધ નહીં.

h.en: Green substation practices and meaningful comparison
h.gu: Green Substation Practices તથા ઉપયોગી Comparison

body.en:
Definition

Green substation practice reduces lifecycle environmental impact while still meeting electrical safety, reliability and service requirements.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Reduce transformer/conductor losses, optimise auxiliary cooling/lighting and reactive support, use condition-based maintenance and plan responsible end-of-life material recovery.
  • Contain insulating-oil spills, manage noise/drainage, recover gases with trained procedures and evaluate lower-impact insulating technologies across lifecycle, not just footprint.
  • Solar auxiliaries/efficient buildings may reduce purchased energy but require dependable backup/DCdesign; an environmental objective never justifies weaker protection.

Worked example / interpretation

  1. An illustrative loss reduction of 2kWfor 4000 h/year saves 8000kWh/year; at₹7/kWhgross energy value is₹56000/year before capital/maintenance costs.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Green practices lifecycle environmental impact ઘટાડે અને electrical safety, reliability/service requirements જાળવે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Transformer/conductor losses, auxiliary cooling-lighting/reactive support optimise; condition maintenance/end-of-life recovery રાખો.
  • Oil spill contain, noise/drainage, trained gas recovery/lower-impact insulation lifecycleથી evaluate કરો—માત્ર footprint નહીં.
  • Solar auxiliaries/efficient building energy ઘટાડે પણ dependable backup/DC જોઈએ; environment goalથી protection નબળી નહીં.

ઉકેલેલું ઉદાહરણ / અર્થઘટન

  1. Illustrative 2kWloss reduction/4000hથી8000kWh/year; ₹7/kWhમાં gross₹56000/year, capital/maintenance પહેલાં.

body.en:
Definition

A suggested activity learning plan, not a claim of performed work.

Working / functional sequence

  1. Review scope, roles, instruments and the approved safe low-energy/model method; write assumptions before building or computing.
  2. Model good/low/bad-quality density signals and alarm/block responses; source names ETAPstudent version.
  3. Check the result independently against the relevant theory and note uncertainty/model limitations.
  4. ETAPlicensing/capability must be checked; Boolean leakage alarms do not simulate physical SF 6leak flow or justify actual gas release.

Detailed explanation and application

  • Model good/low/bad-quality density signals and alarm/block responses; source names ETAPstudent version.
  • ETAPlicensing/capability must be checked; Boolean leakage alarms do not simulate physical SF 6leak flow or justify actual gas release.

Reliability and safety checks

  • Actual observations, date, teacher sign and evidence stay blank until genuinely obtained. All HVwork remains authorised specialist work.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Suggested activity learning plan છે, performed work claim નહીં.

Working / કાર્યનો ક્રમ

  1. Scope, roles, instruments/safe model method review; assumptions પહેલાં લખો.
  2. Good/low/bad density signals/alarm-block model; source ETAPstudent version કહે છે.
  3. Relevant theory સામે independently check/uncertainty-model limitations લખો.
  4. ETAP licence/capability તપાસો; Boolean alarm physical SF 6flow simulation/gas release permission નહીં.

Definition

A source-listed performance exercise: Basic PLCtrainer or virtual operation.

Construction / parts and connections

  1. Resources: vendor-neutral offline PLCBoolean model or supervised isolated 24VDCtrainer; STexample is not claimed compiled for any vendor.

Working / functional sequence

  1. Confirm aim, device identities, ratings, model assumptions and instructor’s safe plan before starting.

Python 3 standard library only. Save as models.py. No equipment I/O, physical test or official VLab execution.

"""Offline educational state models only; no network, device I/O, relay settings or VLab claim."""
from math import sqrt

def recloser(permanent=True,sectionaliser=True,max_trips=3,count_limit=2):
    if max_trips<1 or not 1<=count_limit<max_trips:raise ValueError('Need a restoration attempt after sectionaliser count')
    events=[];fault=True;isolated=False
    for n in range(1,max_trips+1):
        events.append({'event':'TRIP','trip':n,'upstream':'OPEN','fault_isolated':isolated})
        if not permanent:fault=False
        if sectionaliser and fault and n==count_limit:
            isolated=True;fault=False
            events.append({'event':'SECTIONALISER_OPEN','trip':n,'upstream':'OPEN','fault_isolated':True})
        if n==max_trips:
            events.append({'event':'LOCKOUT','trip':n,'upstream':'OPEN','fault_isolated':isolated});break
        events.append({'event':'DEAD_TIME','trip':n,'upstream':'OPEN','fault_isolated':isolated})
        events.append({'event':'RECLOSE','trip':n,'upstream':'CLOSED','fault_isolated':isolated})
        if not fault:
            events.append({'event':'HEALTHY_RESTORED','trip':n,'upstream':'CLOSED','fault_isolated':isolated});break
    return events

def permit(role=True,quality='GOOD',age=0,cb='OPEN',earth='OPEN',code='01',command='CLOSE'):
    # Declared DOUBLE-POINT MODEL mapping only: 00 intermediate, 01 open, 10 closed, 11 bad.
    reasons=[]
    if not role:reasons.append('NO_AUTHORITY')
    if quality!='GOOD' or age<0 or age>2:reasons.append('BAD_OR_STALE')
    if code not in ('01','10'):reasons.append('INVALID_POSITION')
    if cb!='OPEN':reasons.append('CURRENT_NOT_REMOVED')
    if earth!='OPEN':reasons.append('EARTH_NOT_CONFIRMED_OPEN')
    if command not in ('OPEN','CLOSE'):reasons.append('BAD_COMMAND')
    if (command,code)in(('CLOSE','10'),('OPEN','01')):reasons.append('ALREADY_IN_POSITION')
    return {'allow':not reasons,'reasons':reasons,'status_map':{'00':'INTERMEDIATE','01':'OPEN','10':'CLOSED','11':'BAD'}}

def transfer(load_a,load_b,capacity_b,compatible=True,fault=False):
    if min(load_a,load_b)<0 or capacity_b<=0:raise ValueError('Invalid MVA')
    reasons=[]
    if not compatible:reasons.append('INCOMPATIBLE_SOURCES')
    if fault:reasons.append('FAULT_OR_PROTECTION_BLOCK')
    if load_a+load_b>capacity_b:reasons.append('OVERLOAD')
    return {'allow':not reasons,'combined_MVA':load_a+load_b,'reasons':reasons,
            'policy':'Open-transition classroom capacity screen only; actual transfer needs approved order, voltage/phase/protection checks, no unapproved paralleling.'}

def oltc(vin=11000,target=11000,ratio=1.0,step=0.0125,deadband=100,delay=3,elapsed=3,tap=0,min_tap=-8,max_tap=8):
    # Model vout=vin*(ratio + tap*step). Positive tap increases this controlled output ratio.
    if vin<=0 or target<=0 or ratio<=0 or step<=0 or deadband<0 or delay<0 or elapsed<0 or not min_tap<=tap<=max_tap:raise ValueError('Invalid model inputs')
    before=vin*(ratio+tap*step);action='HOLD';aftertap=tap
    if abs(before-target)>deadband and elapsed>=delay:
        wanted=tap+(1 if before<target else -1)
        if min_tap<=wanted<=max_tap:aftertap=wanted;action='STEP'
        else:action='LIMIT'
    elif abs(before-target)>deadband:action='WAIT'
    return {'before':before,'tap':aftertap,'after':vin*(ratio+aftertap*step),'action':action}

def plc(start=False,stop_ok=True,estop_ok=True,overload_ok=True,guard_ok=True,latched=False):
    # No safety certification. Real emergency-stop circuit must be appropriately independent/hardwired.
    q=bool(stop_ok and estop_ok and overload_ok and guard_ok and (start or latched))
    return {'motor':q,'run_latch':q,'alarm':not(overload_ok and guard_ok and estop_ok)}

def fault_zone(zone):
    routes={'FEEDER':{'trips':['FEEDER_CB'],'healthy_bus':True},'TRANSFORMER':{'trips':['HV_CB','LV_CB'],'healthy_bus':False},'BUS':{'trips':['ALL_ZONE_BOUNDARIES'],'healthy_bus':False}}
    if zone not in routes:raise ValueError('Unknown zone')
    return routes[zone]
